== Biography ==
Radeon6870 founded [[Xan]] to compete in the qualifiers for [[Worlds Season 1]]. At the tournament, Xan went 1-2 in the group stage, surprisingly defeating [[TSM]] but losing to [[CLG]] and [[Team gamed!de]], which led to their elimination. Shortly afterward, Xan disbanded, and Radeon6870 retired from professional play to serve his mandatory Singaporean military service.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Radeon6870''' is named after a [https://www.techpowerup.com/gpu-specs/radeon-hd-6870.c256 graphics card].
* Is the older brother of [[Vech]], with whom he competed on [[Xan]] at [[Worlds Season 1]].
** In an interview at the tournament, famously stated "We should have definitely banned [[HotshotGG|HotshotNidaleeGG]]. Basically he kicked my brother in the ass,"<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5S8vOn3KryE xAn Radeon6870 - HotShotnidaleeGG Interview] ''youtube.com''</ref> which became a meme in the community.
* Was Xan's captain and leader.
* At the time of Worlds Season 1, he worked as a part-time laptop salesman.
* His hobbies include reading about the latest graphics card, CPU, desktop model, and PSU reviews.
